SOP.definition: Standing Orders are regular payments of a fixed amount paid to the same recipient on a specified date, for example, to pay rent.

FDP.name: Forward Dated Payment
FDP.definition: Type of Payment used within the New Payments Architecture (UK). Forward-dated payments are one-off payments sent and received on a pre-arranged date, set-up by the customer in advance, for example, to pay a bill.
